gen-gf-grandstander-gf-mukta: Loud, expressive letters with short ascenders and a tall x-height up top. Mukta, with its tall-bodied small letters and slight stroke contrast, makes a long run of text feel unhurried beside the heading's uniform line.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-saira-semi-conden: Grandstander's plain constant-width lines leave its letters held open, with short ascenders and a tall x-height, over Saira Semi Condensed text. Give it big, short lines of display and it earns its keep.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-sofia-sans-conden: Sofia Sans Condensed brings a big x-height and tight ascender room. Grandstander's constant-width display letters take the loud role up top, leaving the body to keep a contemporary, approachable pace.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-victor-mono: Grandstander is all bold, expressive display, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Where it leans on drama, Victor Mono goes precise and structured, a monospace with loose spacing and bowls left open on one side.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-arsenal-sc: Gugi's lowercase climbs almost to cap height, and its curves match its stems exactly, with one fixed nib width throughout. Arsenal SC's faint stroke modulation is the quiet counterweight, visible mainly up close.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-days-one: Tube-like strokes, open-cut terminals, and lowercase nearly as tall as capitals: that's Gugi. Days One meets it with an x-height that fills the line and spacing like rungs on a rope ladder.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-major-mono-display: Major Mono Display reads like neon glass, a monospace with large sidebearings and curves that sweep open. And Gugi's near-capital lowercase and cut-open terminals supply the bolder, distinctive voice.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-martian-mono: Gugi's lowercase climbs nearly to the height of its capitals. Martian Mono, a monospace with generous curve openings and far-apart letters, gives that heading structured, technical company on the page.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-matemasie: Open-cut terminals and lowercase nearly as tall as the capitals give Gugi its bite. Matemasie, a sans with broad gaps between glyphs and small entry points into its round letters, stays easy on the eye line after line.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-momo-trust-display: Distinctive lettering from Gugi, with near-capital lowercase and a blueprint feel of constant line, sets the heading's tone. Momo Trust Display follows with drifting letters and a generous x-height.
